analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is incorrect computation/validation of the CIE instruction end pointer before calling _dwarf_exec_frame_instr(). The code builds instrend as ci_cie_instr_start + (ci_length + ci_length_size + ci_extension_size - (ci_cie_instr_start - ci_cie_start)) and only checks instrend > ci_cie_end. With malformed frame data, this arithmetic can underflow/overflow and produce an invalid pointer that is not caught by that one-sided check, then _dwarf_exec_frame_instr() iterates and dereferences wild memory, causing the ASan SEGV read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via fuzz_set_frame_all on malformed __debug_frame CIE/FDE metadata (including inconsistent lengths/offsets) so that ci_cie_instr_start/ci_length-derived range is invalid. Data flows from fuzz input -> parsed CIE/FDE fields -> _dwarf_get_fde_info_for_a_pc_row() computes instrstart/instrend and invokes _dwarf_exec_frame_instr() with that bad range. The crash occurs when frame op decoding reads past valid mapped CIE instruction bytes.
